title: Chapter 444: No Way To Reverse The Situation
content:
Chapter 444: No Way To Reverse The Situation

Rager looked at Wang Shuo, fighting the monsters alone, and felt that the opponent was at the end of his rope.

He smiled contemptuously.

Seeing the enemy full of despair would make him more excited.

"All troops attack!"

At Rager's command, all the monsters, including Rager himself, rushed out.

Seeing this, Wang Shuo felt bad.

If so many high-level monsters kill on the wall, the consequences will be disastrous.

Wang Shuo immediately released the Ice Phoenix.

Rager ignored Wang Shuo and rushed straight to the Great Wall.

This was not the situation Wang Shuo wanted to see.

So, Wang Shuo took the initiative to approach Rager.

"Hey, monster, your opponent is me!"

Wang Shuo roared, using the verbal taunting skill to attract the boss's hatred.

How can this be tolerated?

It's like you are called an ugly monster by a stranger on the street.

Rager was immediately angry.

On the other side, the Ice Phoenix tried to hold back more high-level bosses as much as possible.

But it was just a drop in the bucket.

A large number of high-level bosses rushed to the top of the city, and the soldiers defending the city were not even a match for them.

A massacre was unfolding on the city wall.

But Wang Shuo no longer had the energy to care about the things on the city wall.

Rag launched a fierce attack on Wang Shuo.

As a demon king, his strength was already top-notch under the strongest king.

But Wang Shuo had the Shura bonus, and once he entered the ranks of high-level generals, his strength was not comparable to that of ordinary high-level generals.

Rag and Wang Shuo were evenly matched.

The two fought back and forth, and the remaining power of the battle killed a large number of demon beasts around.

But this could not change the outcome of the war.

This time, Dahuai Domain was doomed.

Even in the face of a massacre, the reserve soldiers under the city wall bravely rushed to the Great Wall.

Iron-blooded General Ayub was a little bit reluctant to see it.

Before the war, Wang Shuo had already explained it.

If the war fails, retreat is allowed. Try to keep the manpower as much as possible, enter the city for defense, and delay time.

Ayub took a look inside and outside the Great Wall, which was already a purgatory on earth.

There were battles everywhere.

If you retreat at this time, it is very easy to cause the monsters to chase and kill, resulting in the annihilation of the whole army.

But defending the Great Wall and fighting with monsters is not a match at all. After a long time, they will still be slaughtered by monsters.

Difficult!

Difficult!

Ayub felt despair again.

Just like the feeling of powerlessness in the past!

The beloved cannot be protected, and his subordinates cannot be protected!

Full of anger brewing in his heart, he shouted: "No!"

The momentum of his whole body suddenly broke out, breaking through the shackles in an instant and rising to the level of an intermediate general.

The primary general monster that could suppress him before was killed by him in one blow.

Ayub was completely awakened, got rid of the identity of a tool man, and he was free.

But even so, he was still powerless to change the current situation.

The massacre continued.

It suddenly began to rain in the sky.

The rain washed away the blood on the wall and flowed down to the lower part.

For countless years, such things have happened too many times on this Great Wall.

Ayub asked the heavens speechlessly!

Wang Shuo was also dragged down by the thick-skinned Rag and could not break the situation at all.

Just now, he had already used the "Ashura Slash" once, but Rag dodged it and did not cause any substantial damage.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor was besieged by a large group of monsters with the strength of intermediate generals, like a trapped beast.

The entire battle situation was almost powerless to turn the tide.
